title: Apache MXNet 0.11 First Official Incubating Release
summary: Amazon Web Services announced on September 6, 2017 the availability of Apache MXNet 0.11 and described it as MXNet's first official release as an Apache incubating project.
significance: A dated project-governance and release milestone for MXNet under the Apache Software Foundation incubation process, preserved separately from MXNet's earlier development and open-source history.

verification.note: AWS's dated September 6, 2017 release announcement states that Apache MXNet 0.11 was available and that the project had made its first official release as an incubating Apache project. The Apache Software Foundation archive independently preserves a 0.11.0 release directory. This candidate records the Apache-incubating release milestone only; it does not infer MXNet's invention date, original public-release date, development geography, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edges.
